rows.note: Use 邊界 as the all-purpose noun for the separating line between countries or regions.

example.english: This river is the border between two countries.
example.traditional: 呢條河就係兩個國家嘅邊界。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 ho4 zau6 hai6 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 bin1 gaai3

rows.note: Use 邊境 when you mean the frontier area or border region, especially in contexts involving crossing or living near a border.

example.english: They crossed the border this morning.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ziu1 zou2 gwo3 zo2 bin1 ging2

rows.note: Use 邊 for the physical outer edge of an object or area, rather than a political boundary.

example.english: The border of the table is sharp, so be careful.
example.traditional: 張枱個邊好利㗎，小心啲。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 go3 bin1 hou2 lei6 gaa3 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use 花邊 for a decorative edging such as lace or a frilly strip around an object.

example.english: The lace border on this dress is beautiful.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 kwan4 ge3 faa1 bin1 hou2 leng3
